comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Available from Lubeck's Item Shop during the World Clock 16th Century, Phase 4. Pricetag is 200,000 ducats; +1 Swordplay and 3k total fame required to equip. Not color-customizable.

comments.author: NishiK
comments.body:
Also available in Lubeck's item shop during 16th century, phase 3. Price remains 200,000 ducats (and item grants +1 swordplay), but requires 8k fame to equip. Unsure if that's from a game change or it's a variant.

Item is unisex (can be equipped by male or female characters).
